description: Config-only DTDL v2 schema for the gpio / watchdog / thermalprotection MetricTypes. contents[] is empty by design -- describes the devicecfg.json Sensor surface, not a telemetry contract. schemas[] publishes the reusable Enums and the GpioSensorParameters Object (integer-only pinId / pinIds contract) consumed by config-rules.js. GpioPinLevel is retained as an informational Enum.

schemas.description: Allowed MetricType discriminators in this Interface.
Allowed values of Parameters.MetricName when MetricType == 'gpio'. 'pinState' requires Parameters.PinId (v1.0) or Parameters.PinIds (v1.1) or auto-detect.
Allowed values of Parameters.MetricName when MetricType == 'watchdog'.
Allowed values of Parameters.MetricName when MetricType == 'thermalprotection'.
Logical level for a GPIO input pin. The agent emits the underlying integer value; consumer dashboards may resolve to the named label via this Enum.
Allowed values of SensorGroup. GPIO pinState uses 'DI'; capability flags (gpio.isSupported, watchdog.isSupported, thermalprotection.isSupported) use 'SYS'.
Allowed values of SensorInfo.Schema. For this Interface: 'boolean' for every *.isSupported, 'integer' for gpio.pinState.
Reusable Object schema for the Parameters block of every gpio Sensor in devicecfg.json. Field names use camelCase here; on-the-wire keys are PascalCase (the agent matches case-insensitively).
schemas.comment: Pin identifiers are integer indices only; resolved at runtime via PinIndexToName[index]. DTDL v2 has no cross-field constraints, so one rule lives outside the schema (enforced by config-rules.js): pinId and pinIds are mutually exclusive when both non-empty. pinId and pinIds apply only when metricName == 'pinState'.

fields.name: metricType
fields.description: Metric-family discriminator. For this Object MUST equal 'gpio'.

fields.name: metricName
fields.description: Specific GPIO query (see GpioMetricName enum). 'isSupported' takes no extra parameters; 'pinState' uses pinId / pinIds.

fields.name: pinId
fields.description: Single GPIO pin INDEX (e.g. 4). Non-negative integer; resolved via GpioMetrics.PinIndexToName[index] to a pin name, then looked up in PinStateDetails. v1.0 mode: required for metricName=pinState. v1.1 mode: optional; when set disables expansion.

fields.name: pinIds
fields.description: Array of GPIO pin INDICES (e.g. [4, 17, 27]). All entries non-negative. v1.1 only. Each entry becomes one expanded sensor sharing the GpioPinState Telemetry DTMI; resolved via PinIndexToName[index]. Empty array means auto-detect across every entry of GpioMetrics.PinNames.

schemas.description: Reusable Object schema for the SensorInfo block of every Sensor in devicecfg.json. Models the wire-output metadata: declared schema, operator-facing display strings, and the read/write directionality contract.
schemas.comment: SIL2 read-only contract: every Sensor declared in devicecfg.json represents an agent-emitted reading. Consumers MUST set isReadable=true and isWritable=false; the agent rejects writes (WriteSensorDataAsync returns false) and commands (ExecuteCommandAsync returns CommandNotSupported) by design. A future writable GPIO-output extension would introduce its own MetricType with isWritable=true; existing read-direction MetricTypes never flip writability.

fields.name: schema
fields.description: On-the-wire JSON type the agent emits for this Sensor's Value (matches the per-MetricName schema documented in the *_FIELDS.md reference). The agent rejects startup if SensorInfo.Schema disagrees with the runtime type.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Long-form operator-facing description shown in dashboards and audit logs.

fields.name: displayName
fields.description: Short label for UI render (twin pages, alert subjects). Distinct from Sensor.Name, which is the wire identifier.

fields.name: isReadable
fields.description: True when the Sensor produces readings the agent forwards as telemetry. MUST be true for all sensors declared in this Interface (the agent is read-direction by design). Default: true.

fields.name: isWritable
fields.description: True when the Sensor accepts writes from the cloud. MUST be false for every sensor declared in this Interface; the agent rejects writes and commands per SIL2 fail-safe contract. Default: false.
